annotations.text: The shipped podium is one card capped at 620pt, sized for a phone and shown at that size on every desktop. Here the ending owns the window: one measure up to 1040pt, type scaled with it, and less than the card carries today, since watch replay and the banked readout are gone.

The page reads SCORE, SAY, NEXT MATCH, SHARE. Every header sits over a rule, padded equally off the head and the content; the clock stands beside a drain in the score bar's language, and sharing is one key, the full measure wide.
Upright, the sides stack at full width instead of halving the measure, so a name and its figures stop fighting for the same 180 points. Every key is 44pt or taller.
On a phone held sideways the sections hold: SAY's grid stands beside NEXT MATCH over SHARE, so the reading order survives the short measure.
